jobs.description:
About Consilium At Consilium Safety Group, we don’t just build technology — we create solutions that protect people, assets, and the planet. As a global leader in fire and gas safety, we serve critical industries including marine, energy, rolling stock, and infrastructure.
With more than 100 years of expertise, we combine deep industry knowledge with cutting-edge innovation to shape the future of Safety Tech. Headquartered in Gothenburg, Sweden, and operating in over 55 locations worldwide, Consilium is a fast-growing global organization backed by Antin Infrastructure Partners. With strong financial support and a clear strategic vision, we are on an ambitious journey of growth and transformation — investing in innovation, operational excellence, and talent.
This is an exciting time to join us.

The Role
As Head of Product Line – Fire Detection, Building & Rolling Stock, you will hold strategic responsibility for a key part of Consilium's portfolio, driving innovation, business alignment, and long-term growth.
You will lead the development and execution of a forward-looking product strategy that supports our business objectives and strengthens our position in the global safety market. Managing a global team of Product Managers and Product Specialists, you will foster collaboration across regions and functions while building a strong "One Consilium" culture.
You will own the full product lifecycle, from roadmap and portfolio management through to market positioning and business performance. Working closely with R&D, Operations, Sales, and other key stakeholders, you will ensure our solutions meet customer needs, regulatory requirements, and the highest performance and safety standards.
You will also play a central role in identifying new business opportunities, driving profitable growth, and ensuring strategic initiatives are delivered on time and on budget.

Key Responsibilities

Define and execute the product line strategy for Fire detection, Building and Rolling Stock solutions

Lead, develop, and grow a global team of Product Managers and Product specialists

Own portfolio management, product lifecycle planning, and roadmap prioritization

Partner with R&D and Technical leadership to maximize business value and ROI from development investment

Identify market trends, customer needs, and new growth opportunities

Support the commercial organization in hitting sales and profitability targets

Optimize pricing strategies, margins, and product positioning

Ensure accurate forecasting, reporting, and data-driven decision-making

Represent Consilium in customer meetings, industry forums, and strategic partnerships

Champion cross-functional collaboration and a strong global team culture

Your Profile
We are looking for a strategic and commercially minded leader with a passion for technology, innovation, and safety. 
You likely have:

A university degree in Engineering, Technology, Business, or equivalent experience

Proven experience in a technology industry with regulated, safety-critical products. Direct exposure to fire detection, building safety, or rolling stock is a strong advantage

Proven experience within the safety technology industry, ideally related to fire detection, building safety, or rolling stock

Strong leadership experience, including leading and motivating international teams

A solid understanding of product management, product lifecycle processes, and business-driven product development

Experience working in global and cross-cultural environments

Strong business acumen with experience managing budgets, profitability, and growth targets

Excellent analytical and strategic thinking skills

Experience with agile development methodologies is considered a strong advantage

Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken

To succeed in this role, you are a collaborative and inspiring leader who combines strategic thinking with a hands-on approach. You are comfortable navigating complex global environments and enjoy building strong relationships across functions and markets.

What We Offer
At Consilium, you will have the opportunity to make a real impact in a global company at the forefront of safety innovation.
We offer:

A key leadership role with global influence

The opportunity to shape the future of safety technology

A collaborative and international work environment

A culture driven by innovation, responsibility, and continuous improvement

Competitive compensation and benefits

Opportunities for professional and personal growth

Ready to Make an Impact?
If this sounds like your next challenge, we would love to hear from you.
Apply today and become part of a company committed to innovation, safety, and sustainable global growth.
Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Collaborate with development teams to streamline software delivery.

jobs.occupation: Head of Public Affairs at Volvo CE
jobs.description:
Company description:
Volvo Construction Equipment 
Job description:    The construction equipment industry is undergoing a major transformation. Electrification, digitalization, sustainability ambitions, industrial policy and geopolitical developments are reshaping the conditions for our industry. At Volvo Construction Equipment (Volvo CE), we are committed to driving this transformation and building the world we want to live in for our customers, employees and society. 
 We are looking for an experienced and business-oriented Head of Public Affairs to shape the external policy environment, strengthen strategic partnerships and translate political and regulatory developments into business opportunities. 
 This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of business strategy, technology, geopolitics and public policy in one of the world's leading industrial companies. You will advise senior executives on developments shaping our industry, represent Volvo CE in influential external arenas and help define the conditions for future competitiveness and sustainable growth. 
 What you will do 
As Head of Public Affairs, you will lead Volvo CE's Global Public Affairs agenda, serve as a strategic advisor to senior leadership and represent the company in dialogues with policymakers, regulators and other key stakeholders. 
 Working closely with Volvo Group Public Affairs and colleagues across Volvo CE, you will ensure that our business priorities are reflected in relevant policy discussions and advocacy initiatives. 
 Your key responsibilities will include: Shape and execute our Public Affairs agenda: Develop and implement Volvo CE's Public Affairs strategy in close coordination with Volvo Group Public Affairs, aligned with business priorities and long-term competitiveness. 
 Anticipate,  interpret and influence external developments: Monitor, analyze and influence political, regulatory, economic and geopolitical developments across Swedish, European and international arenas. Translate insights from policy, industry trends, research and broader societal developments into business opportunities and strategic guidance.  
 Advise senior leadership: Provide actionable insights on political, regulatory and geopolitical developments, supporting business strategy and executive stakeholder engagement. 
 Lead strategic advocacy: Develop evidence-based policy positions, advocacy plans and key messages in close collaboration with strategy, technology, sustainability, communications, legal and commercial functions. 
 Build trusted partnerships: Develop and maintain relationships with policymakers, government authorities, industry associations, NGOs, think tanks and customers, positioning Volvo CE as a trusted and constructive partner in the transition towards more sustainable and productive solutions. 
 Drive external engagement: Represent Volvo CE in industry forums, policy discussions, executive roundtables and strategic external engagements, acting as a trusted ambassador for the company among influential stakeholders in Sweden, Europe and globally. 
 Strengthen Group-wide collaboration: Coordinate Volvo CE's contributions to Volvo Group Public Affairs initiatives and policy positions, ensuring alignment with Group priorities while advancing the interests of the construction equipment business. 
 Who are you? 
You are a strategic, proactive and results-oriented professional who combines political understanding with sound business judgment. 
 You build trust and credibility with senior stakeholders, communicate complex issues clearly and drive results through collaboration and influence rather than formal authority. 
 You are comfortable working independently in an international environment, balancing long-term strategic objectives with effective execution. You have a genuine interest in understanding the forces shaping society, business and industry, and enjoy staying ahead of developments through policy analysis, research, global trends and geopolitical developments. 
 Above all, you are motivated by the opportunity to contribute to Volvo CE's competitiveness and the transformation of the construction equipment industry. 
 We are looking for an experienced Public Affairs professional with strong political judgment, business acumen and a proven ability to influence policy outcomes. 
 To be successful in this role, we believe you bring: 
  Significant relevant experience, ideally in Public Affairs, government relations, regulatory affairs or a related strategic function, gained in industry, government or relevant organizations. 
 Strong knowledge of Swedish and European political institutions, regulatory frameworks and decision-making processes, with an international perspective. 
 Proven experience in developing advocacy strategies, influencing policy developments and advising senior executives. 
 Solid business and industrial understanding, with the ability to connect political and regulatory developments to business strategy and commercial opportunities. 
 A relevant university degree in political science, law, economics, business administration, engineering or a related field. 
 Excellent communication, stakeholder management and influencing skills, with fluency in English & Swedish. 
  
Additional merits include: 
  Experience from construction equipment, automotive, transport, energy or other industrial sectors. 
 Established networks within relevant political institutions, government agencies and industry organizations. 
 Experience working with EU industrial, climate, trade or competitiveness policies.
